name: rdi-recruiter-module
description: RDI Recruiter Module - Recruiter View for managing student proposals

scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const v = process.version; const major = parseInt(v.slice(1).split('.')[0]); if (major !== 20) { console.error('ERROR: Node.js version ' + v + ' is not supported. Please use Node.js 20 LTS.'); console.error('Run: nvm use 20'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Node version check passed: ' + v);"
